limitations: Explicitly configured public channel uploads playlist, first page max20, at most two playlists per refresh. No hidden channels request or pagination. Metadata only; channel coverage is not all YouTube. Disabled until configured and enabled.

One request for at most 20 previously discovered/configured public video IDs. Views/likes/comment counts only; no comment text. Views are play-start counts since 2026-08-24, not unique people, purchases or comparable to older definitions. Live status is workspace-specific; inspect source capabilities.
Recently created repositories ranked by current stars, not measured star growth. API search is bounded; popularity and author claims are not customers or commercial viability.
English developer community selection bias. Points and current hits are not growth rates or representative Korean demand.
Review current API terms, permission and commercial restrictions; do not claim a connector or unrestricted reuse before approval.
Patent filing vs grant dates, jobs duplication, pledges vs fulfilled sales and regional applicability need separate adapters and evidence checks.
Top search results, not a census. total is indexed results, not query demand. News syndication is not independent corroboration.
Public search metadata only. Advertising and SEO bias; no private accounts, identity profiles or full-text harvesting.
Indexed public snippets only; not access to private cafe posts. Unavailable publication dates remain unknown.
Relative index, not absolute searches. Compare periods within one identical request window, not independently rescaled snapshots.
Trending Now selects news-related spikes; not a complete early-demand feed. Bucketed traffic is not a full time series or customer demand.
Public RSS endpoint can change. Metadata only. Aggregator URLs may obscure origin and overlap with Naver news; do not count these as independent families.
Search listing only; views/likes are not fetched. regionCode and relevanceLanguage do not prove Korean audience. Retain metadata at most 28 days and recheck provider policy.
One bounded page of announcements; never all grants. Dates and eligibility must be checked against the current official notice and attachments.
Official alpha access is limited. Do not fabricate a general-availability endpoint; import authorized exports until approved.
Meta professional-account permissions and permitted public-content scope only; not unrestricted consumer or private-account access. Provider approval precedes implementation.
Research API eligibility and commercial-use restrictions need review; do not bypass login, rate limits or access controls.
Separate platform contracts, keys, budgets and retention policies needed; no universal scraping connector.
Official dataset verified; API adapter is not implemented or tested. Use official notices and authorized normalized imports.
Select statistical table, units, reference period and revisions; query-time is not observation-time.
Economic series require table/unit/frequency and release-vintage alignment.
Check current law, effective date and jurisdiction for the actual business. Not legal advice.
Old Naver shopping search ended in 2026. Shopping Insight click index is not sales. Use permitted merchant/partner exports with units, dates and denominator.
YC, Product Hunt, THE VC, innovation ecosystem data have distinct coverage and rights. Verify company assertions and paid-data license.
